text: Entry Requirements 1. Non Chinese citizens aged 18-30, graduated from high school or equivalent educational one, physically and mentally healthy (without color blindness or color weakness). 2. Those whose parents (one or both) are Chinese citizens and have settled in a foreign country, who have foreign nationality at the time of their birth, and who immigrate from the Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan to foreign countries, as applicants for studying in China, must hold valid foreign passports or international certification documents for at least 4 years, and there is a record of actual residence abroad for at least 2 years in the past 4 years (as of April 30th of the enrollment year). 3. Language Proficiency Requirements: Applicants must have proof of HSK Level 4 (no less than 180 points) or other equivalent Chinese proficiency tests. Those whose medium of instruction during the whole learning period of the highest academic qualification is Chinese can be exempted from the certification of Chinese test results, but must submit the certification of Chinese teaching issued by the graduation college or university. 4. The previous academic performance shall meet one of the following requirements: (1) Excellent performance in senior high school graduation examinations, with the score of mathematics no less than 70 points (out of 100 points), and the score of either physics or chemistry also no less than 70 points (out of 100 points). (2) Having completed the Preparatory program recognized by our university and met the graduation standards. 5. A score not lower than 70 points (on a 100-point scale) in the entrance interview (conducted remotely or on campus). 6. CSCA score report: Mathematics is a compulsory subject; either Physics or Chemistry may be chosen as an additional subject.
